title: A plan to self-host a code-hosting service with its administrator console on the public internet behind only a login, a floating image tag, no patch owner or cadence and no version inventory, while CI runners hold deploy keys

planted.why: the code host and its administrator console are reachable by anyone; a login page and two-factor authentication do not protect the code that runs before authentication, so one pre-authentication flaw exposes all source and the production deploy keys
no named owner, no routine, no urgent-advisory path and no inventory of the running version or image digest, on a service whose critical flaws are published and exploited within hours
